source: CONTRACTS.md §1.4 (engine rules), R3.1 (protocol.*, aesi.clock_started and tier.protocol_floor rules from the EMPOWER-Lung 1 protocol tables protocol_rules.json / irae_mapping.json) and R2.4 (chartscan.* rules of the chart-note scanner ported from omer-khawar/ae-checkin-agent, Omer Khawar, MIT). Every rule id the engine or the scanner can emit is listed here; eval personas reference these ids.
rationale: A closed catalog lets the dashboard, the eval harness and the audit log agree on rule identity. description_template documents the plain-English sentence each rule produces (placeholders in braces are substituted with the actual values at run time). Per-item rules (score.composite.*, grade.provisional.*) are listed once per shipped item so the catalog is exhaustive without wildcards.

rules.description_template: Red flag: shortness of breath severity {severity} (Severe or Very severe) -> tier floor 3
rules.emitted_when: shortness_of_breath.severity >= 3

rules.description_template: Red flag: fever or chills present with severe item(s) {severe_items} -> tier floor 2
rules.emitted_when: fever_or_chills present AND any severe item

rules.description_template: Red flag: hospital admission or ER visit reported -> tier floor 3; seriousness suspected
rules.emitted_when: hospitalization gate = yes

rules.description_template: Red flag: free-text comment present with severe item(s) {severe_items} -> tier floor 2; flag for human read (text is never parsed)
rules.emitted_when: other_text non-empty AND any severe item

rules.description_template: Red flag: the participant says they are having trouble breathing, or chest pain or tightness, right now -> tier floor 3; the kiosk stops at once
rules.emitted_when: urgent_now gate = yes (R5.1; asked first because urgent symptoms must not wait for twelve more questions: 2026-10-11 playtest)

rules.description_template: Red flag: the check-in was ended early by the urgent path (ended_early = {ended_early}) -> tier floor 3; unanswered items are not reported
rules.emitted_when: POST /sessions/{id}/urgent (trigger urgent_now or severe_dyspnea) (R5.1)

rules.description_template: Red flag: the participant's own words in the comment box say {quotes} -> tier floor 3
rules.emitted_when: the deterministic scanner (utterance mode) finds a red-flag phrase in other_text, urgent or emergency level; a hospital/ER mention that conflicts with a No answer adds the conflict reason and starts the SAE clock (R5.2)

rules.description_template: Red flag: the participant asked to talk to a person in the comment box -> tier floor 2
rules.emitted_when: the deterministic scanner finds a request for a person in other_text (R5.2)

rules.description_template: Vitals: no samples were captured for this session; check-in evaluated without vitals
rules.emitted_when: no samples

rules.description_template: Vitals: {n} sample(s) captured but no metric reached confidence {min_confidence} with a valid averaging window ({n_low} low-confidence, {n_short} window-too-short reading(s)); vitals ignored
rules.emitted_when: no sample-metric reaches min_confidence with window_s >= min_window_s (a confidence that is missing, not finite or outside 0..1 counts as low)

rules.description_template: Vitals: sample {sample_id} {metric} = {value} {unit} is outside plausibility bounds {min}-{max}; ignored for rules
rules.emitted_when: one per sample with an implausible confident metric

rules.description_template: Vitals: all usable samples are SIMULATED ({source}) and 'treat simulated as measured' is OFF; summarized but not eligible for corroboration
rules.emitted_when: every usable sample is simulated and the toggle is off (a sample whose source is in simulated_sources is simulated whatever its is_measured flag says; such samples are listed in inputs.measured_flag_inconsistent_samples)

rules.description_template: WARNING: demo toggle ON - {n} SIMULATED sample(s) are being treated as measured for corroboration
rules.emitted_when: toggle on and at least one simulated sample is usable

rules.description_template: Vitals summary over {n_eligible} usable of {n_samples} samples ({measured_label}): pulse median {pulse_median} max {pulse_max}; breathing median {breathing_median} max {breathing_max}
rules.emitted_when: at least one usable sample

rules.description_template: Corroboration: shortness of breath composite {composite} >= 2 and max breathing rate {breathing_max} >= 24 breaths/min -> tachypnea corroborates reported dyspnea (+1 tier)
rules.emitted_when: vitals status ok and condition true

rules.description_template: Corroboration: shortness of breath composite {composite} >= 2 and max pulse {pulse_max} >= 110 beats/min -> tachycardia with reported dyspnea (+1 tier)
rules.emitted_when: vitals status ok and condition true

rules.description_template: Corroboration: fever or chills present and max pulse {pulse_max} >= 110 beats/min -> tachycardia with reported fever or chills (+1 tier)
rules.emitted_when: vitals status ok and condition true

rules.description_template: Base tier {base_tier} from highest provisional grade {max_grade}
rules.emitted_when: always

rules.description_template: Red-flag floor {floor} raises tier {base_tier} -> {floor}
rules.emitted_when: floor > base tier

rules.description_template: Vitals corroboration adds one step: tier {before} -> {after} (at most vitals_corroboration.json max_tier_bump steps, capped at max_tier)
rules.emitted_when: a corroboration rule fired with vitals status ok

rules.description_template: Protocol floor {floor} raises tier {tier_before} -> {floor} (possible protocol deviation, coordinator to confirm)
rules.emitted_when: a prohibited con-med was reported (protocol_rules.json conmeds.prohibited_tier_floor) and the floor is above max(base tier, red-flag floor); applied before the vitals bump (CONTRACTS.md R3.1)

rules.description_template: Final escalation tier {tier} ({name}): {action}
rules.emitted_when: always

rules.description_template: Seriousness suspected (hospitalization/ER). Site became aware at {site_awareness_at}; investigator-to-sponsor report due {due_at} (24 h)
rules.emitted_when: hospitalization gate = yes

rules.description_template: Con-med '{verbatim}' matched exactly to '{matched_name}' (confidence {confidence})
rules.emitted_when: exact string match

rules.description_template: Con-med '{verbatim}' matched case-insensitively to '{matched_name}' (confidence {confidence})
rules.emitted_when: case-insensitive match

rules.description_template: Con-med '{verbatim}' matched to '{matched_name}' at edit distance {distance} (confidence {confidence})
rules.emitted_when: Levenshtein distance <= 2

rules.description_template: Con-med '{verbatim}' did not match the bundled list; kept verbatim for the coordinator (nearest: {candidates}) | Con-med: a medication change was reported but no medication name was typed; kept empty for the coordinator to ask the participant
rules.emitted_when: no match, a Levenshtein near-miss below min_levenshtein_confidence, or a 'yes' to the con-med gate with no name typed

rules.description_template: {aedecod} reported again {days_since} day(s) after open AE {ae_open_id} (within {window_days}-day window) -> follow-up, no new AE
rules.emitted_when: same AEDECOD open within window

rules.description_template: {aedecod}: no open AE within {window_days} days -> new AE
rules.emitted_when: no eligible open AE within window (an open AE last reported by this same session, or dated more than max_future_skew_s after this check-in, is skipped and listed in inputs.open_aes_skipped)

rules.description_template: AE draft {aeseq}: {aedecod}, provisional grade {grade}{followup_note}
rules.emitted_when: one per AE draft

rules.description_template: VS draft {vstestcd}: {vsorres} {vsorresu} ({vsmethod}, n={n_samples})
rules.emitted_when: one per VS summary row

rules.description_template: CM draft: '{cmtrt}' -> {cmdecod} ({match_kind}, confidence {confidence})
rules.emitted_when: one per CM draft

rules.description_template: Possible adverse event of special interest (possible AESI, investigator to confirm): {labels}. {label}: provisional grade {grade} (provisional, investigator to confirm) on a potentially immune-related item ({irae_category}). Protocol §9.4.3, p. 92 lists '{criterion}'. The protocol asks for AESI reports within 24 hours of identification.
rules.emitted_when: a provisional grade >= 3 on an item irae_mapping.json marks potentially immune-related, or grade >= 1 on such an item when protocol_context.prior_pi3k_inhibitor is true (protocol_rules.json aesi.criteria); never changes a grade or the tier

rules.description_template: 24-hour AESI clock started (possible AESI, investigator to confirm). The site became aware at {site_awareness_at}; the report to the sponsor is due {due_at} (24 h, protocol §9.4.3, p. 92: same process as an SAE report)
rules.emitted_when: protocol.aesi_suspected fired; CheckInResult.aesi_clock has kind 'aesi', due = completed_at + protocol_rules.json aesi.reporting_hours

rules.description_template: No second AESI clock for {label} (open AE {ae_open_id}) (possible AESI, investigator to confirm): this check-in is a follow-up of an open AE that already has a 24-hour AESI clock, so the existing clock stands (one event, one clock)
rules.emitted_when: protocol.aesi_suspected fired and a suspected item is a dedup follow-up of an OpenAE with aesi_clock_started = true; when every suspected item is covered, CheckInResult.aesi_clock is null

rules.description_template: Medication '{verbatim}' is {drug}, which the protocol does not allow (§7.7.1, p. 69: '{quote}'). Possible protocol deviation, coordinator to confirm; tier floor 2
rules.emitted_when: the reported medication matches protocol_rules.json conmeds.prohibited by medlist match or by a whole word/phrase of the verbatim text (any direction: a stopped prohibited drug was still taken during the study)

rules.description_template: Medication '{verbatim}' is {drug}, a systemic corticosteroid the protocol recommends avoiding (§7.7.2, p. 69) '{exception_text}' Coordinator to check the reason with the study team; tier unchanged
rules.emitted_when: the reported medication matches conmeds.discouraged and the text has no non-systemic qualifier (cream, ointment, drops, inhaler ...)

rules.description_template: Medication '{verbatim}' is {drug}, which the protocol permits (§7.7.2, p. 69: '{quote}'). Condition: '{condition}'. No protocol issue; tier unchanged
rules.emitted_when: the reported medication matches conmeds.permitted

rules.description_template: The protocol asks for each medication's generic name, dose, dose unit, frequency, indication and start/stop date (§7.7, p. 69). Still missing for '{verbatim}': {missing}. Coordinator to ask the participant
rules.emitted_when: a medication change was reported; lists the protocol_rules.json cm_required_fields a kiosk CM draft cannot fill (INTERIM_CM_MISSING_FIELDS)

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' -> {term}, provisional grade hint {grade_hint} ({grade_basis}); onset {onset_days} day(s) before the note; worsening; resolved per the text
rules.emitted_when: one per kept symptom finding of a scanned chart note (interim_rules.chartscan.rules_fired); the API drafts an AE with AEDECOD = term, AETOXGR = grade hint (never above composite_to_grade.max_assignable_grade), INTERIM_SOURCE = chart_note; inputs.resolved = true when the text says the symptom resolved (the API may propose AEENDTC)

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' ({term}) skipped: {excluded_reason}: {reason}
rules.emitted_when: one per excluded symptom mention (negated, historical, hypothetical); no draft

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' -> {drug} ({change}): {reason}
rules.emitted_when: one per kept medication finding; the API drafts a CM with CMTRT = quote, CMDECOD = drug, CMSTDTC/CMENDTC from change

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' ({drug}) skipped: {excluded_reason} ({reason})
rules.emitted_when: one per excluded medication mention (allergy, negated); no draft

rules.description_template: Chart note red flag ({level}, {category}): {reason} -- '{quote}'
rules.emitted_when: one per red-flag category matched (first non-excluded match); a note escalates to Tier 2 at most and never pages or shows a stop screen (D-017)

rules.description_template: Chart note mentions hospitalization or an ER visit ('{quote}') -> seriousness suspected (ICH E2A); the SAE clock starts when the site reads the note
rules.emitted_when: a red flag of a seriousness category (hospitalization) fired; the API sets seriousness_suspected and starts the SAE clock with site_awareness_at = ingested_at

rules.description_template: Second reader: '{quote}' -> {term}, provisional grade hint {grade_hint} ({grade_basis}). The reader only found the words; the grade is the scanner's rule
rules.emitted_when: one per symptom the second reader (Gemini, CONTRACTS.md R5.3) found that the scanner did not, after interim_rules.llm_verify accepted its quote (found word for word), its term (closed vocabulary) and its status (current or resolved); the API drafts an AE with INTERIM_SOURCE = chart_note and the evidence pointer marked found_by = gemini. The grade hint comes from the scanner's own grading of the quote's sentence (stool bands for a counted diarrhea), never from the model

rules.description_template: Second reader: '{quote}' -> {drug} ({change}): {reason}
rules.emitted_when: one per medication the second reader found that the scanner did not, after the quote was found word for word and the medication name appeared inside it; the API drafts a CM with CMTRT = quote and the evidence pointer marked found_by = gemini

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} has AESER = {value} but no signed serious-event report; query raised for the coordinator (protocol §9.4.2, p. 91)
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed AE record reaching the mock EDC (or an admin re-run) has AESER = Y and no signed packet for its clock (edit_checks.json)

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} is grade {grade} (provisional) on a potentially immune-related term but INTERIM_IRAE = N; the sponsor may request more information (protocol p. 91-92)
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed AE with AETOXGR >= 3 on an irae_mapping.json potentially immune-related term carries INTERIM_IRAE = N

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} ends {value}, before its start {other_value}
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed AE has AEENDTC earlier than AESTDTC

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} is missing protocol-required fields {missing_fields} (protocol §7.7, p. 69)
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed CM record lacks any of protocol_rules.json cm_required_fields (CMENDTC not required for an ongoing medication)

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} carries protocol flag {flag} with no investigator note (protocol §7.7.1-7.7.2, p. 69)
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed CM has INTERIM_PROTOCOL_FLAG prohibited or discouraged and no investigator note

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} value {value} {unit} is outside {low}-{high} {unit} (vitals_corroboration.json plausibility)
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed VS PULSE/RESP value lies outside the physiological plausibility bounds

rules.description_template: Edit check (sponsor side): the {record_label} has outcome {value} but no AEENDTC
rules.emitted_when: a confirmed AE has a resolved AEOUT and no AEENDTC
